note: The pack has no original/finished pixel-aligned pairs. These cases define expected crop behavior and must receive human rectangles before numeric accuracy is reported.

required_order.label: deck low light
required_order.crop_policy: same complete-board crop; preserve pressure-ding visibility

required_order.label: bottom low light
required_order.crop_policy: same complete-board crop; preserve pressure-ding visibility

required_order.label: rail full light
required_order.crop_policy: preserve full rail/rocker and any protruding fins; no warping

optional_order.label: fins close-up
optional_order.crop_policy: preserve original detail framing unless reviewer adjusts it

gallery_contract.naming_note: Deck/bottom are intentional gallery labels; low-light views remain separate because they reveal pressure dings.

sequence_variants.rule: The optional photo may be absent; absence is not a failure.
If present, retain the extra photo as its own gallery item and classify it independently.

cases.pattern: upright board on gray wall/floor, light board with dark traction pad
rules: include complete nose and tail
include traction pad and attached leash plug
exclude cast shadow where possible
keep a small, configurable margin rather than cropping to the shadow
if_clauses: if the board edge is low contrast against the wall, do not use the shadow as the board boundary
if the floor/wall seam is inside the candidate box, it is background, not a board landmark

cases.pattern: bottom view with visible fin boxes/fins and strong board graphics
rules: include every attached fin and protruding fin tip
include tail shape and all rails
do not mistake dark fins, logos, or traction material for background
if_clauses: if fins extend beyond the main silhouette, expand the crop to include them
if a fin is visually merged with the board, use its attached geometry rather than color alone

cases.pattern: very thin board with visible rocker; some images include a support stand
rules: preserve the full rocker from nose to tail
preserve protruding fins and rail curvature
do not straighten, rotate, or warp the board
use a minimum crop width so the board is not rendered as a sliver
if_clauses: if a support stand is visible, exclude it when possible without clipping the board or fins
if the board and stand touch, route to review instead of guessing the separation
if the profile nearly disappears against the wall, keep the full frame as a safe fallback

cases.pattern: optional extra photo; partial, close-range accessory/condition shot; board continues beyond the frame
rules: preserve original framing by default
do not try to find a complete board silhouette
do not expand or invent missing content
if_clauses: if the image is partial or close-range, classify as detail even when board pixels dominate
if no full-board candidate is visible, keep original rather than forcing a board crop

cases.pattern: optional extra photo present for some boards, absent for others
rules: do not require this photo for every board
if present, preserve it as a separate source and export item
classify it independently from full-board and profile views
if_clauses: if a board has no separate fins close-up, do not create a placeholder
if fins are visible in a normal face or rail shot, that does not make the shot fins_closeup
if the extra photo is a close-up, keep original framing unless the reviewer chooses a crop

cases.pattern: multiple views of the same board with different pressure dents, graphics, and fin layouts
rules: keep every source photo as a separate gallery item
apply crop independently per photo
never deduplicate by visual similarity
if_clauses: if two views belong to one board, group them but do not merge their files
if a paired view has a different crop need, preserve that correction independently
